classes.derivation_class: EXTRACT-2 CR 106.4 template / grammar §4 ratified verb
classes.inclusion_reason: prints the CR 106.4 `add {mana}` template. NAMED FOR THE RATIFIED PRIMITIVE, NOT FOR THE FAMILY: grammar §4's `add-mana` verb is Captain-ratified with CR 106.4 supplying the words verbatim, and it is the objective stand-in for §21's 'ramp'. The two are NOT the same set — a Cavern of Souls adds mana and is fixing, not acceleration — and closing that gap needs a ratification this packet is not allowed to make
exile followed by return in one sentence — the §20 C2 blink test's own printed shape

classes.derivation_class: EXTRACT-1 CR 701 keyword action + packet-1 boundary test
classes.inclusion_reason: prints CR 701.5 `counter` as an effect head in PREDICATE position — the boundary test is what keeps '+1/+1 counter' out
carries an object-lattice class on destroy / exile / bounce — the ratified removal machinery, not a hand tag

classes.derivation_class: EXTRACT-4 printed zone-change template + CR 205.2a/205.3 land vocabulary via the ratified lattice parse
classes.inclusion_reason: one sentence carries both the `put … onto the battlefield` zone change and a CR 205-anchored `‹land type› card` object. Search is NOT required — Settle the Wilds seeks and Arboreal Grazer plays from hand, and a search-gated arm would call neither one ramp

classes.derivation_class: EXTRACT-2 CR 106.4 template + CR 305.2 rate + EXTRACT-0 type line
classes.inclusion_reason: prints the CR 106.4 add-mana template — BOTH printed forms, the mana symbol and the noun — on a card with no Land type. CR 305.2 rations a player to one land per turn, so mana from a nonland source is mana that did not cost the rationed drop. This is the arm Captain's ruling names: an ordinary basic land is NOT ramp by its mana ability alone, and the nonland cut is what enforces that

classes.derivation_class: EXTRACT-2 CR 111.10 closed list x CR 106.4 template
classes.inclusion_reason: creates a CR 111.10 predefined token whose CR-PRINTED ability itself matches the CR 106.4 add-mana template. Two CR rules meeting decide the membership, so the token set is derived and not named — it comes back as four, and the fourth is one no hand list here would have contained
